gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Verifies that ZippingIterator can be constructed with three iterators without throwing any exceptions.
ADDED i3: Verifies that calling remove() before any element has been returned via next() throws IllegalStateException with message "No value can be removed at present".
ADDED i6: Verifies that remove() succeeds after forEachRemaining() has consumed the last element. forEachRemaining() internally calls next(), which sets the last-returned
ADDED i7: Build a no-op closure: OnePredicate with empty array always returns false, so IfClosure never executes the chained (empty) closure body.
ADDED i8: Consume the single element; internally calls next(), setting lastReturned
ADDED i9: remove() is now valid because lastReturned is set from the forEachRemaining call
ADDED i10: Verifies that calling next() on a ZippingIterator wrapping only empty iterators throws NoSuchElementException.
